info.title: TrialShopy API
info.description: TrialShopy Backend APIs (Website + Mobile). Protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT — click **Authorize** and paste your token. Standard envelope: `{ success, message, data }`.

bearerAuth.description: JWT issued on login/verify-otp. Send as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

email.description: Email (may be synthetic for phone signups)

isNewUser.description: True if the account was just auto-created

imageUrl.description: Absolute primary image URL for mobile

post.summary: Register a new customer with email + password
post.description:
Creates a new customer account for the mobile app and returns the same JWT
as login (so the app logs the user in immediately). Reuses the website
user-creation logic; the website endpoint POST /api/v1/userSignUp is
unchanged. **Auth required:** No (public).
**Used in screen:** Sign Up. **Trigger:** "Create account" button.

post.summary: Request an OTP for login or signup
post.description:
Sends a one-time password to the given mobile number.
**Purpose:** start phone login/signup. **Who:** any app user.
**Used in screen:** Login / OTP. **Trigger:** "Get OTP" button.
**Auth required:** No.

post.summary: Verify OTP (logs in; auto-creates account if new)
post.description:
Verifies the OTP and returns a JWT. If the number is not registered,
a minimal account is auto-created (zero-friction signup).
**Used in screen:** OTP. **Trigger:** "Verify" button. **Auth required:** No.

Resends a fresh OTP to the number. **Used in screen:** OTP.
**Trigger:** "Resend OTP" link (after cooldown). **Auth required:** No.

Authenticates a customer with email + password and returns the same JWT as
OTP login. Reuses the website auth logic. **Auth required:** No.
**Used in screen:** Login. **Trigger:** "Login" button.

post.summary: Register a device for biometric login (enrollment)
post.description:
One-time enrollment, called after a normal login. The app generates a key
pair in the device secure enclave/Keystore (private key protected by
Face ID / fingerprint) and registers the PUBLIC key here. The server never
sees the private key. **Auth required:** Yes (Bearer JWT).

post.summary: Get a one-time biometric login challenge
post.description:
Returns a random challenge the app must sign with the device private key
(after a biometric prompt). Valid for 120s, single use. **Auth required:** No.

example.message: Device not registered for biometric login

post.description:
The app sends the base64 signature of the challenge (signed with the
biometric-protected private key). The server verifies it against the stored
public key and returns the same JWT as OTP/email login. **Auth required:** No.
**Flow:** register (once) → challenge → biometric.

example.message: No valid challenge. Request a new challenge.
Device not registered for biometric login
